_comment: Copy this file to playlists.json and edit it. staging_path is a folder on your computer where the master copy of your library lives - it's always fully synced there regardless of anything below. usb_drive_path is where that library additionally gets mirrored: a USB stick, an MP3 player, any folder. Update it if a drive letter changes. Leave it as an empty string to skip mirroring entirely and just keep the library local.
_codec_note: Audio format yt-dlp extracts to. 'mp3' is the safest, most widely-compatible default for car head units and MP3 players. 'vorbis' (ogg) also works if you prefer smaller files and your target device supports it.
_playlists_note: tidal_name must match the exact playlist name as it appears in your Tidal account. name is used as the local folder name for that playlist's songs. Order matters here - playlists are resolved/downloaded top to bottom, so the most-wanted ones are listed first.
